spec_match.rationale: The probe calls the real static surface (Proofreader.availability with expectedInputLanguages, Proofreader.create, proofread) and displays the raw availability enum without rebucketing, but downloadable/downloading states get no explanation and the correction-detail fields (type, startIndex) from the explainer are not surfaced.

interactive.rationale: Probe API and Proofread buttons both act on real user input from the textarea; the fallback heuristic still produces visible, editable-input-driven output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede and the flag banner accurately describe the probe-then-fallback behavior, and the stub is announced in the status line when used.

edge_cases.rationale: Unavailable and create-failure paths are handled, but the stub itself has a visible bug (the hear/here rule's word-boundary regex never matches the sample's "hear.", so the advertised sample correction silently drops) and no quota/language-mismatch cases are shown.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus entry and the feature index are linked from the see-also section.

conformance.rationale: FLAG FOR HUMAN (immutable suite, not edited): five script assertions in v139/proofreader-api/conformance.json (proofreader-exposed, proofreader-availability-method, proofreader-create-method, proofreader-proofread-on-prototype, proofreader-destroy-on-prototype) are of the form typeof Proofreader==='undefined' || <check>, so they can never fail; in this Chromium 141 run the panel showed 6/6 PASS including 'Proofreader is exposed on the global' while the page's own probe correctly reported window.Proofreader undefined — a contradictory capability state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless-Chrome CDP run 2026-08-16: Probe API reported the honest stub message, Proofread produced 5 labelled stub corrections, zero console errors and zero failed requests; full-page screenshot read and legible.

telemetry_health.rationale: No window.showcaseTelemetry assert calls exist on this page, so neither the real-API path nor the stub path records a contract signal.

design_system.rationale: All colours come from shared variables (including the defined --accent-amber), correction chips are white-on-emerald/rose at AA, and buttons keep the paired background/colour override.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons and the textarea have accessible names and visible focus, but the status line and corrections output have no role/aria-live, so probe results and correction lists are announced nowhere for screen readers.

openQuestions.title: Human review needed: unfalsifiable conformance assertions produce false PASSes
openQuestions.detail: The five Proofreader script assertions pass when the API is entirely absent (typeof Proofreader==='undefined' || ...). The visible support panel therefore claims PASS for 'Proofreader is exposed on the global' in browsers with no Proofreader at all, contradicting the page's own probe. Existing assertions are immutable for this routine; a human should rewrite them as real exists/typeof checks that fail (or report blocked) when the API is absent.

openQuestions.title: Announce probe and proofread results to assistive tech
openQuestions.detail: Give the #status element role=status (polite live region) and make the corrections container a labelled region or live region so stub/real results are perceivable without vision.

openQuestions.title: Fix the stub's hear/here rule and add telemetry asserts
openQuestions.detail: The /\bhear\.\b/ regex never matches because \b cannot sit between '.' and a space; the default sample advertises a correction that never appears. Also add showcaseTelemetry asserts for the real-API and stub branches.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric's accessibility and runtime_evidence scores applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's primary controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Honest probe/fallback page whose own runtime behavior verified cleanly, but the sibling immutable conformance suite contains unfalsifiable assertions that display contradictory PASSes — flagged for a human. Accessibility live-region and stub-regex fixes are actionable follow-ups.
